integrity_notes: Complete analytic statement and proof are included, with a standalone generator-based numerical cross-check. Correlation-sign thresholds are not thermodynamic phase transitions. Existing general propagator theory may encode special cases; publication priority is qualified. Independent validation is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Strictly zero-temperature one-dimensional nearest-neighbor Glauber dynamics; simultaneous Poisson resets to independently fair-phased alternating Néel states; even finite rings or infinite lattice; no generalization to non-Poisson times, positive temperature or arbitrary reset configurations. Finite checks support but do not establish infinitely quantified claims.
title: Nested correlation-sign thresholds in a Neel-reset kinetic Ising chain
